title: SPEC-0NN Trust kit v1 (citations v2, viewer, masked PII, unlock), docs/contracts/c04-citations-viewer.md, glossary additions and the task plans
acceptance: SPEC, contract doc and glossary PR merge with ACs keyed to SHL-07a-e and SHL-08a-f/h, cite ADR P-48, ADR-066, ADR-004 and ADR-110, and are approved by ayushkbhatia.

title: C4 stub PR: CitationV2 union of 10 kinds, CitationDisplay, ViewerManifest, regions, search, reveal, unlock and reserved create models with classification tags; fixture-returning route stubs; evidence matrix and flag sections; make generate
acceptance: The generated client exposes every C4 operation returning seed-derived fixtures behind evidence.* flags, each route declares one matrix action, and agent principals are denied every human-only action.

title: C4 consumer contract tests: pytest against the stub in backend/tests/contracts/c04_citations_viewer/
acceptance: The suite asserts shapes, refusal codes, human-only actions, audit event names and footing figures (14,895,000.00 + 1,605,000.00 = 16,500,000.00; 6,200 x 25% = 1,550) and runs in the provider's CI.

title: Migration trust_kit_v1: citations, citation_events, evidence_pages, pii_scan_runs, pii_regions, pii_reveals, evidence_derivations; derivation_id and mask_version on upload_extractions and upload_previews; enums, RLS, insert-only triggers, evidence registry entries
acceptance: The migration upgrades and downgrades cleanly, every new table is tenant-RLS and insert-only for all roles, and the single-head check passes.

title: Word-box layer: UploadProcessing patched step words (pdfplumber extract_words in the isolated child) writing a sealed per-tenant layer and evidence_pages rows; v4 replay history; idempotent backfill workflow
acceptance: Every text-layer page of a new upload gets word boxes in page points, the v1-v3 histories still replay, and the evidence bytes and fingerprint are unchanged.

title: Citation v2 verifier registry evidence.register_citable with built-in verifiers document_text (page, bbox, quote hash on the word layer), sheet_cell and request_item; match_id derivation; agents citations.py and document_citations.py become adapters
acceptance: A fabricated page, bbox, quote or value is stored unverified with a reason, no citation fails only for a missing bbox, and the existing citation unit tests pass unchanged.

title: Fixture scenarios screens/SHL-07 (a-e) and screens/SHL-08 (a-f, h) typed against C4, page PNG and region fixtures for the seven scenario documents, DF-31 status words and copy-registry strings
acceptance: /components/screens/SHL-07?st=a-e and SHL-08?st=a-f,h render from fixtures at the 9:24 and 9:41 AM CT clocks with figures that foot.

title: Citations read API: GET /v1/citations/{id} display contract (title and loc rendered by code, quote re-read from the layer and hash-checked) and GET /v1/citations (anchor stack, host section, source version, kind) on the P-36 envelope with visible() and a used_in count
acceptance: A walled or client principal gets 404 or 403, an unverified citation is never returned as verified, and no quote text is stored in the database.

title: Viewer endpoints: GET /v1/evidence-versions/{v}/viewer manifest, /pages/{n} (masked rendition only), /regions?match_ids= and /search?q= over the word layer; legacy upload and inbox preview routes delegate
acceptance: The manifest carries geometry only, search returns rects only and never logs the query, and client-scope versions resolve through visible().

title: Persist screener, upload-reviewer and matcher citations as v2 rows (created_by_kind agent, run_id, bbox from the word layer) inside the handoff unit of work
acceptance: Each verified agent citation becomes one row that resolves to a lit region, and the screening, upload_review and matching suites hold citation_verification 1.0 and every other threshold.

title: SHL-07 CitationPopover container: single (a), stack with stepper, ghost edges and page thumb (b), methodology guidance 420 (c), hover preview vs pinned (d), Source moved with Re-link (e); Citations (n) and Procedures (n) list popovers; quotes through AgentText
acceptance: Hover intent 150 ms previews at 95% opacity, click pins and keeps the ring, Escape closes and refocuses the cell, and an unverified citation never renders as fact.

title: Moved and broken detection: outbox consumer on superseding evidence versions (plus methodology and workpaper slots) writing citation_events and citation.moved; POST /v1/citations/{id}/relink as a human-only re-verification on the successor
acceptance: A superseded source marks dependent citations moved within one relay cycle, a relink from an agent or worker context is refused, and a human relink writes a new verified row and an audit event.

title: PII detection by code: UploadProcessing patched step pii_scan over the word layer (label-anchored SSN, ITIN and EIN; bank account and ABA routing with checksums; DOB near labels) into pii_regions with sealed values; synthetic PII corpus in abacus_tools/synthetic/documents.py
acceptance: The seeded corpus (W-2 box a 000-00-6081, K-1 EIN, 1099 recipient TIN) is detected at recall 1.0, and pages without a text layer are recorded not_scannable, never silently clean.

title: SHL-08 EvidenceViewer on two hosts (O2 drawer ?ov=viewer, T2 dock ?dock=viewer): drawer (a), pane with TB re-target (b), loading (e), source 2 of 3 (f), auto-highlight outlines (h); linked-figure card, stacked edges, Also cited, page and zoom controls, Download only in the menu
acceptance: The lit figure row and page region share one match, the region scrolls to 30% from the top, and no raw file, pdf.js or toolbar Download ever appears.

title: Masked renditions and masked agent material: patched step masked_preview burns opaque boxes into page PNGs in the isolated child; match material, review material, document text and search hits carry mask tokens; verifier runs on the masked projection; backfill
acceptance: No served page has unmasked pixels inside a detected region, no agent input contains an unmasked TIN pattern, and agent quotes of masked text still verify.

title: Logged reveal: POST /v1/evidence-versions/{v}/pii-reveals with pii.reveal (not_offshore, mfa_recent for TIN kinds, agent and client roles denied), a pii_reveals row, a pii.revealed audit event without the value, 20 per user per hour, no-store
acceptance: An onshore engagement member gets the value with expires_in 30 and an audit row naming them, while an offshore member, an agent or a client principal is refused and nothing is revealed.

title: Code-only citation conformance suite evals/citations/suite.yaml (fabricated page, bbox, quote, value, unicode, moved, masked quote) plus citation_region_resolved as a report-only metric in the screening, upload_review and matching suites
acceptance: Fabrication caught and valid citations accepted are both 1.0 on the seeded set, and no existing threshold is lowered.

title: Independent AC tests (ADR-078) for citations v2 and the viewer: schema immutability, verifiers, word-layer replay, citations and viewer APIs, agent persistence, moved and relink, walls (Lena Park on Ashford), client principals, cross-tenant reads
acceptance: Every C4 read and the relink action pass INV-1, INV-2 and INV-3 assertions written in a separate session from the implementation.

title: Password unlock: POST /v1/evidence-versions/{v}/unlock decrypts, extracts, word-boxes, scans and renders masked pages in one isolated child inside the request into evidence_derivations; SecretStr never logged, stored or sent to Temporal; 5 attempts per 15 minutes; password_pdf synthetic generator
acceptance: A correct password yields masked pages linked to the untouched original version, a wrong one returns attempts_left, and the password appears in no log, table, storage object or workflow history.

title: SHL-08 masked PII (c) and password-locked (d) plus in-document search: MaskedValue with Reveal (logged), MFA step-up, 30-second re-mask and the logged line; unlock form, error copy and the Ask client prefill into SHL-14; flag-off states
acceptance: The clear value lives only in component memory for 30 seconds and is never cached, persisted or put in the URL, and Ask Jonah & Claire Feld... opens SHL-14 prefilled.

title: Independent AC tests (ADR-078) for PII detection, masked renditions, agent masking and reveal: corpus recall, pixel inspection of every served rendition, reveal matrix, MFA, rate limit, audit row without the value
acceptance: Every reveal refusal path and the no-unmasked-pixel property are proven by tests written outside the implementing session.

title: Independent AC tests (ADR-078) for password unlock: sentinel password absent from logs, database, storage, Temporal history and error tracking; original fingerprint unchanged; derived records linked; attempt limit
acceptance: A planted sentinel password is found nowhere outside the request, and the evidence version's bytes and fingerprint are identical before and after unlock.

title: Independent AC tests (ADR-078) for the amber viewer UI: MaskedValue lifecycle (nothing in the query cache, browser storage, URL or DOM after re-mask), the unlock form never echoes or stores the password, reveal and unlock absent from agent surfaces
acceptance: After re-mask or unmount no copy of the revealed value or the password remains in the DOM, browser storage or React Query cache.

title: Fixture-mode Playwright specs e2e/trust/shl-07-citation-popover.spec.ts and e2e/trust/shl-08-source-viewer.spec.ts; parity at Tier C for SHL-07a-e and SHL-08a-f,h with Tier D assertions; axe AA, keyboard and reduced-motion checks
acceptance: Both specs pass in fixture mode with axe clean, Tier D assertions blocking, and SHL-07a/b/e and SHL-08a/b/c/d/e locked at Tier C.

title: Full-stack E2E on staging: extend e2e/journeys/J04-pbc-slice.spec.ts with the trace-to-source step (AUD-03 screening citation to SHL-07 to SHL-08 lit) and add e2e/trust/pii-reveal-unlock.fullstack.spec.ts, both with assertInvariants
acceptance: Both specs pass nightly against staging with INV-1 to INV-5 asserted in the browser and database modes.

title: Runbook docs/runbooks/RB-31 PII reveal review and unlock abuse, pii.reveal-volume and unlock-failure alarms on the security dashboard, evidence README, temporal-workflow and ai-agent skills, flag expiry entries, TASK-057 supersession closed
acceptance: The runbook answers who saw this SSN from pii_reveals and audit events, both alarms fire in a staging drill, and the four evidence.* flags carry owners and expiries of at most 90 days.
